notes.title: Devlog #1 February 2025
notes.notes:
[b][h2]Greetings, fellow Hoover Heroes! 👋🏻🫧
[/h2][/b]
Get ready for the wildest party brawl ever, where only the last one standing claims victory! Your mission is simple: clean up, but with a twist! In Hoover Heroes, you’re not just here to tidy up; you’re part of a team of cleaners sent on wild assignments by your agency. The first stop? A laundromat that quickly turns into chaos. Why? Because the best cleaner of the month gets the prize and that’s where things get complicated. Instead of cleaning, your team of cleaners starts fighting to claim the title of "Kevin of the Month." 🫡🧼

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471804/a5ae045c20a6686842f8f6fa974567f63d600c0c.gif[/img]

And who better to lead the charge than Kevin? Our jiggly, squishy hero may look soft, but don’t be fooled, Kevin is as competitive as they come. Whether bouncing across the arena or getting caught in chaotic clashes, Kevin embodies everything that makes Hoover Heroes a hilarious and intense experience. At the heart of the mayhem is your trusty vacuum cleaner. Forget about cleaning around, you are using it to launch objects, push rivals, and make a mess of the arena. Your vacuum cleaner will be full after you have picked up 3 objects. Charge them up before hurling them across the stage. Whether it’s a heavy, slow-moving object or a light, fast projectile, the choice is yours, and each throw can change the course of the fight.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471804/b0b60359ce1fc3ac25096b6914b653d91d1a8c5d.gif[/img]

But that’s not all - you can use your vacuum to push opponents or launch an air burst to escape tight situations. Whether you’re dodging incoming objects or forcing your rivals into dangerous spots, your vacuum’s got your back.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471804/9ad258679c5d152f7c1377966b36ba6df62a137e.gif[/img]

[b]The Slap That Keeps On Giving 🔥[/b]
And don't forget the slap! With three quick mini slaps or one charged slap, you can knock out rivals and send them flying. Time it right, and you'll leave your competition in the dust.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471804/c8d8f351601a2b437dab7f2c55be4ded4d871c27.gif[/img]

📖 Let’s break down what makes Hoover Heroes a hilarious and strategic party brawl:

[b]Chaotic Missions, Wild Fights[/b]
You’re not just cleaning; you’re fighting for the top spot in your agency! Complete missions while outsmarting and outmaneuvering the other cleaners in this unpredictable brawl. Each location brings new challenges, but the true goal is to knock out the competition and claim the title of Kevin of the Month.
[b]
Master Your Vacuum[/b]
Your vacuum isn’t just for sweeping up dust—it’s your ultimate weapon! Whether it’s a quick burst or a full-on charged launch, mastering your vacuum will determine who wins the battle.
[b]
Dodge, Push, Throw, Slap! 🌪️[/b]
The action doesn’t stop with just throwing objects. Use your vacuum to push enemies, dodge incoming attacks, and stay in the game as the last cleaner standing. It’s all about being faster, and messier than the rest!

And remember, this is just the beginning! The full game will introduce even more locations and brawls, each with new ways to outplay your rivals. Stay tuned for more details as we continue to develop the chaos-filled, object-hurling madness of Hoover Heroes!

So, if you haven’t yet, add Hoover Heroes to your wishlist and prepare for a brawl like no other! 💨🌪️
